config.from-stone-to-stars.title: From Stone to Stars
config.from-stone-to-stars.generatePebbl: Place pebble patches in the overworld. Requires a game restart. Already generated chunks are unchanged.
Write extra diagnostic messages to the log.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.tanning_rac: Hang raw leather on the rack. After five minutes each hide becomes leather. Keep it under cover — rain resets drying progress. Take finished leather with an empty hand, or sneak to remove everything.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.kindling: Lights charcoal piles and brick drying pits. Charcoal: one log with four kindling. Bricks: five kindling (center plus four around it), wet clay bricks above the center, and four charcoal blocks on the outer kindling. Light any kindling with a bow and drill.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.bow_and_dri: Age 0 fire starter. Lights a charcoal pile or a brick drying pit. Four uses.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.charcoal_bl: Made in a charcoal pile, not a furnace. Crafts back into charcoal. Also used as the cover on a brick drying pit.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.bone_saw: Use on top of a log to place the saw. Right-click the placed saw to cut the log into 4 matching planks. The saw is returned.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.raw_leather: Dropped by animals instead of leather. Dry it on a tanning rack before cutting strips or making a crafting table.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.pebble: Found on the ground. Nine pebbles compact into cobblestone. One cobblestone splits back into pebbles.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.bark: Strip a log with any axe. Two bark and two sticks craft kindling.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.hammerstone: Crafted from a pebble. Breaks gravel and is used to sharpen bone. It has two uses.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.clay_bricks: Craft two clay balls into wet bricks. Place them, then use more of the same bricks on the pile to stack up to three. Fire in a drying pit: five kindling, wet clay bricks above the center, four charcoal blocks on the outer kindling. Light with a bow and drill. Takes five minutes.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.fired_clay_: Fired from wet clay bricks in a drying pit. The charcoal cover and kindling are consumed. Stack count is kept from the wet pile. Used to build a basic smelter.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.basic_smelt: A slow clay blast furnace. Smelts blasting recipes (ores) at half speed. Craft from fired clay bricks and a charcoal block.
